pages.text: The best weapons in the pack drop only from bosses, and every kill banks Combat-lane tokens. Each tier has required progression bosses and optional trophy ones.$(br2)$(bold)Simply Swords uniques$() are boss-drop-only: {{uniques kind=sword count}} swords, plus {{uniques kind=bow count}} Too Many Bows bows, each matched to a boss ($(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Unique Weapons$(/l)). None can be crafted, traded for or found in chests.

$(bold)Boss Mods Active$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Brutal Bosses$(): structure-guarding mini-bosses, all tiers$(li)$(bold)Meet Your Fight$(): Swampjaw and the Bellringer ({{boss meetyourfight:swampjaw tier}} minibosses), Dame Fortuna and Rosalyne ({{boss meetyourfight:dame_fortuna tier}} bosses)$(li)$(bold)Mutant Monsters$(): Overworld and dimensional mutant variants$(li)$(bold)Terramity$(): structure bosses from Tier 1 up

$(li)$(bold)Cataclysm$(): T3 and T4 ultra-bosses in massive structures$(li)$(bold)Ultimate Bosses$(): optional superbosses called inside its towers on Overworld hills: the Storm (five Phantom Membranes, {{boss ub:storm tier}}), the Sorcerer (a Nether Star, {{boss ub:sorcerer tier}}), the Lost Angel (Dragon's Breath)$(li)$(bold)Stalwart Dungeons$(): T3 dungeon bosses$(li)$(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$(): spellcaster bosses and minibosses, all {{boss irons_spellbooks:dead_king tier}}

$(bold)Progressive Bosses$()$(br2)This mod runs the Wither you summon. It does $(bold)not$() make a boss stronger each time it is killed: your first Wither and your tenth are the same fight.$(br2)A Wither built with $(bold)Corrupted Soul Sand$() is stronger than a plain one. The pack keeps one of those forms, the $(l:icraft:bosses/t4_bosses)Ultimate Wither$(/l), as a Tier 4 challenge in the Nether.

$(bold)Per-kill scaling$()$(br2)Bosses remember who has beaten them. The first time a boss trades a hit with a player, it takes the $(bold)highest$() kill count of that boss among the players within 64 blocks and keeps it for the whole fight.$(br2)Everyone within 64 blocks when it dies counts the kill. $(bold)/icraft bosskills$() shows your counts.

$(bold)How much stronger$()$(br2)Fight 2: +15% health, +10% damage, +3% speed$(br)Fights 3-4: +30 / +20 / +5%$(br)Fights 5-6: +50 / +35 / +8%$(br)Fights 7-9: +75 / +48 / +10%$(br)Fights 10-14: +100 / +60 / +12%$(br)From fight 15: +150 / +80 / +15%$(br2)Melee damage only. Never scaled: the Wither, the Ender Dragon, the Warden, the Elder Guardian.

$(bold)Bosses & Progression$()$(br2)Every boss kill banks Codex tokens in the $(bold)Combat$() lane, more at higher tiers. Kills also count toward the $(bold)boss rush$(): clear $(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() / $(t3){{tier 2 rushpct}}$() / $(t4){{tier 3 rushpct}}$() of a tier's bosses to advance without banking any tokens.$(br2)Boss $(italic)materials$() drop too. They are crafting spoils, not progression currency.$(br2)$(bold)Next: $(l:icraft:bosses/t1_bosses)Tier 1 Bosses$(/l), then /icraft codex bosses.$()
